# 混合电推进与系统集成

_Hybrid-Electric Propulsion & Integration_

NASA 将电气化推进按电能来源和功率传递方式区分为多种构型。串联、并联和涡轮电推进等方案，在能量路径、部件需求和整机集成上各有不同。

_NASA distinguishes electrified propulsion architectures by their energy sources and power paths. Series, parallel and turboelectric arrangements differ in component requirements and whole-aircraft integration._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先画出燃料、电池、发电机、电机和推进器之间的功率流。

_Trace power between fuel, batteries, generators, motors and propulsors._

- 一起考虑电机、电力电子、配电和热管理，避免只比较单个部件效率。

_Assess machines, power electronics, distribution and thermal management together._

- 记录概念研究、地面试验和飞行演示的实际阶段。

_Record whether the evidence concerns a concept, ground test or flight demonstration._
